linkedin.headline: Architect | Vance Pell Studio
linkedin.about: I design small civic buildings and renovations. I am wry, thoughtful and I enjoy history, museums, cinema and photography. I value creativity, integrity and a calm, unhurried life. Looking for someone who likes a long film, a museum afternoon and honest, thoughtful conversation.

experience.title: Architect
experience.description: Lead design on civic buildings and heritage renovations.

posts.caption: Museum afternoon and a cinema double bill. Calm, unhurried, perfect.
Photography walk through a brutalist estate. Wry smiles from passers-by.
Heritage site visit, history in every brick.
Cosy evening in with an old film and a pot of tea.
